verdict.rationale: Conductor is a product that handles user code and chats, including in cloud workspaces, so a training opt-out or no-training policy is a fair question to ask. The pack has no documented training opt-out, no-training commitment, or data-usage policy. A developer comment says messages stay between the user and the local Claude Code installation, but it predates cloud workspaces and does not address model training. Community members also note that data practices are not disclosed.
